head_commit.message:
fix(cycles): the on-demand Create AGENTS.md entry is a cycle root

The rulesFile bundle (5e212d1b9's parent chain) added
src/host/commands/rulesFileEntry.ts as a build entry without listing it in
scripts/cycles.json, so hosted run 6 failed the three root-coverage cases of
test/unit/cyclesRoots.test.ts on every system. Listed now; cyclesRoots 4/4
and the cycle check exit 0.

Local full unit suite on this Windows PC (vitest, 9,322 tests): 9,245 passed,
5 failed. Four are EPERM creating symlinks (this account has no symlink
privilege; hosted Windows runners do): reports.e2e, checkSlots, promptStore,
teamGitIndexLock. acpStdio.e2e failed one case under the full run's load and
passed 13/13 alone; that cause is unmeasured.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<email-redacted>>

head_commit.message:
docs(release): the measured cause of the red VSCodium job on the released commit

The 0.18.2 record said the cause of the red "VSCodium latest" job in Hosts
run 38329749606 was not yet measured. It is now, on the probe branch
probe/vscodium-focus (head 703d5d58f, never merged), Hosts runs
38335980951, 38336295689 and 38336506352: a chat panel whose webview
finishes loading focuses its own composer and takes the active editor from a
document opened in the meantime. In 14 of the 20 jobs that kept recording
after the check it happened 0.4 to 0.8 seconds after showTextDocument had
resolved; in one the check itself never saw AGENTS.md active. A defect of
the product since 2026-09-21 (fb1166ec6f), in none of the files 0.18.2
changed; its fix is the next release's work.

PLAN.md section 10 says the same in one clause (PLAN.md 3,564,752 bytes,
406 under its archive threshold).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<email-redacted>>

head_commit.message:
fix(testing): the real-life run starts npm and the agent with no shell

The hosted scan (`build / semgrep`) failed the pull request on one line:
scripts/real-life/lib/install.mjs ran `npm install` as one shell line with
`shell: true` (rule spawn-shell-true). The install now starts npm's own
command script under the Node that runs the run, as an argument array with
no shell, the way scripts/audit.mjs starts it: the script that started the
run (`npm run real-life`), or the one that ships beside Node. On POSIX,
where `npm` is a program, it is started by name when no script is found; on
Windows, where it is a command script only a shell starts, the run stops
with "npm was not found beside Node". Nothing is ignored and no rule is
changed.

The same class, swept: scripts/real-life/lib/product.mjs started the agent
with a Node path handed in on an object (`product.node`), which the scanner
on this PC (semgrep 1.177.0) names under detect-child-process although the
hosted one (1.178.0) did not. That value was always `process.execPath`; the
agent is now started with `process.execPath` itself and the field is gone.

Checked on Windows, with no key and no model request: the published
0.18.1 agent tarball installed into a new folder in 2 s with
`npm_execpath` not set; `exec --help` exit 0; the editor protocol answered
`initialize` and the process ended with exit 0; `semgrep scan --config
auto --error` over these three files: no finding. The POSIX branch was not
run: no POSIX machine was available for it today.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<email-redacted>>
